integrity: Full analytic proof with a reproducible direct-semantics exhaustive checker for all 66066 relations on chain sizes 1 to 4. Finite tests are not the proof of the all-n statement.
scientific_limitations: Fixed n-world labelled intuitionistic chains and operations induced by unrestricted binary flat-frame relations only; not all abstract algebraic expansions or constrained frame classes. The partial-permutation sequence was known; an earlier equivalent semantic classification remains a priority risk.
title: Last-occurrence matchings and exact realization fibers for finite flat Heyting–Lewis chains
